## Idea

A {{#concept "left ideal generated by an element" Disambiguation="semiring" Agda=left-ideal-element-Semiring}} `x` of a [semiring](ring-theory.semirings.md) `R` is the [left ideal generated by the subset](ring-theory.left-ideals-generated-by-subsets-semirings.md) containing only the element `x`. In other words, the left ideal generated by `x` is the least [left ideal](ring-theory.left-ideals-semirings.md) that contains the element `x`. In informal writing, the left ideal generated by the element `x` is denoted by `⟨x⟩`.

We note that left ideals generated by an element need not be [subtractive](ring-theory.subtractive-left-ideals-semirings.md). For instance, consider the ring `R := {0,1,∞}` with addition and multiplication tables given by

```text
  + | 0 1 ∞    × | 0 1 ∞
  ---------    ---------
  0 | 0 1 ∞    0 | 0 0 0
  1 | 1 ∞ ∞    1 | 0 1 ∞
  ∞ | ∞ ∞ ∞    ∞ | 0 ∞ ∞
```

Then the left ideal `⟨∞⟩ = {0,∞}` generated by `∞` is not subtractive, since two out of three of `∞ + 1 = ∞` are in the left ideal `⟨∞⟩`, but `1 ∉ ⟨∞⟩`.

## Definitions

### The predicate of being a left ideal generated by an element

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (x : type-Semiring R)
  (J : left-ideal-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring : UUω
  is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring =
    {l3 : Level} (K : left-ideal-Semiring l3 R) →
    leq-left-ideal-Semiring R J K ↔ is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R K x

  contains-element-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring :
    is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring → is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R J x
  contains-element-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring U =
    forward-implication (U J) (refl-leq-left-ideal-Semiring R J)

  leq-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring :
    is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring →
    {l3 : Level} (K : left-ideal-Semiring l3 R) (k : is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R K x) →
    leq-left-ideal-Semiring R J K
  leq-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring U K =
    backward-implication (U K)
```

### The left ideal generated by an element of a semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (x : type-Semiring R)
  where

  generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    subset-Semiring l1 R
  generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    subtype-standard-singleton-subtype
      ( set-Semiring R)
      ( x)

  left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    left-ideal-Semiring l1 R
  left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    left-ideal-subset-Semiring R generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring

  subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    subset-Semiring l1 R
  subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    subset-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    type-Semiring R → UU l1
  is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-prop-is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    (r : type-Semiring R) → is-prop (is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring r)
  is-prop-is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-prop-is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  type-left-ideal-element-Semiring : UU l1
  type-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    type-subset-Semiring R subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring

  inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    type-left-ideal-element-Semiring → type-Semiring R
  inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    inclusion-subset-Semiring R subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring

  ap-inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    (y z : type-left-ideal-element-Semiring) → y ＝ z →
    inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring y ＝
    inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring z
  ap-inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    ap-inclusion-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-in-subset-inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    (y : type-left-ideal-element-Semiring) →
    is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring
      ( inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring y)
  is-in-subset-inclusion-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-in-subset-inclusion-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    {y z : type-Semiring R} →
    is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring y →
    (y ＝ z) → is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring z
  is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-element-Semiring' :
    {y z : type-Semiring R} →
    is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring z →
    (y ＝ z) → is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring y
  is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-element-Semiring' =
    is-closed-under-eq-left-ideal-Semiring' R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-left-ideal-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-left-ideal-subset-Semiring R subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring
  is-left-ideal-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-left-ideal-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-additive-submonoid-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-additive-submonoid-subset-Semiring R
      subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring
  is-additive-submonoid-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-additive-submonoid-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  contains-zero-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring (zero-Semiring R)
  contains-zero-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    contains-zero-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-closed-under-addition-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-addition-subset-Semiring R
      subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring
  is-closed-under-addition-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-addition-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subset-Semiring R
      subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring
  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-left-ideal-Semiring R
      left-ideal-element-Semiring

  additive-submonoid-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    Submonoid l1 (additive-monoid-Semiring R)
  additive-submonoid-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    additive-submonoid-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring

  contains-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-in-left-ideal-element-Semiring x
  contains-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring =
    contains-subset-left-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring)
      ( x)
      ( refl)

  leq-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    {l3 : Level} (I : left-ideal-Semiring l3 R) →
    is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R I x →
    leq-left-ideal-Semiring R left-ideal-element-Semiring I
  leq-left-ideal-element-Semiring I H =
    leq-left-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring)
      ( I)
      ( λ { x refl → H})

  abstract
    is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
      is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x
        left-ideal-element-Semiring
    is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring J =
      is-least-subtype-containing-element-standard-singleton-subtype-Set
        ( set-Semiring R)
        ( x)
        ( subset-left-ideal-Semiring R J) ∘iff
      is-left-ideal-generated-by-subset-left-ideal-subset-Semiring R
        ( generating-subset-left-ideal-element-Semiring)
        ( J)
```

## Properties

### Any two left ideals generated by the same element contain the same elements

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (x : type-Semiring R)
  (J : left-ideal-Semiring l2 R)
  (U : is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x J)
  (K : left-ideal-Semiring l3 R)
  (V : is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x K)
  where

  has-same-elements-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-left-ideal-Semiring R J K
  pr1 (has-same-elements-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring r) =
    leq-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x J U K
      ( contains-element-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring
        R x K V)
      ( r)
  pr2 (has-same-elements-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring r) =
    leq-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x K V J
      ( contains-element-is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring
        R x J U)
      ( r)
```

### Any left ideal that has the same elements as the left ideal generated by an element `x` satisfies the universal property of the left ideal generated by the element `x`

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (x : type-Semiring R)
  (J : left-ideal-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-has-same-elements-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-left-ideal-Semiring R
      ( left-ideal-element-Semiring R x)
      ( J) →
    is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-Semiring R x J
  is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-has-same-elements-Semiring H K =
    logical-equivalence-reasoning
      leq-left-ideal-Semiring R J K
      ↔ leq-left-ideal-Semiring R (left-ideal-element-Semiring R x) K
        by
        iff-Π-iff-family
          ( λ y →
            ( λ f → f ∘ forward-implication (H y)) ,
            ( λ f → f ∘ backward-implication (H y)))
      ↔ is-in-left-ideal-Semiring R K x
        by
        is-left-ideal-generated-by-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring
          R x K
```

### The left ideal `⟨x⟩` is trivial if and only if `x ＝ 0`

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (x : type-Semiring R)
  where

  is-trivial-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-zero-Semiring R x →
    is-trivial-left-ideal-Semiring R (left-ideal-element-Semiring R x)
  is-trivial-left-ideal-element-Semiring p =
    is-trivial-leq-left-ideal-Semiring R
      ( left-ideal-element-Semiring R x)
      ( trivial-left-ideal-Semiring R)
      ( is-trivial-trivial-left-ideal-Semiring R)
      ( leq-left-ideal-element-Semiring R x
        ( trivial-left-ideal-Semiring R)
        ( is-closed-under-eq-trivial-ideal-Semiring' R
          ( contains-zero-trivial-ideal-Semiring R)
          ( p)))

  is-zero-is-trivial-left-ideal-element-Semiring :
    is-trivial-left-ideal-Semiring R (left-ideal-element-Semiring R x) →
    is-zero-Semiring R x
  is-zero-is-trivial-left-ideal-element-Semiring H =
    H (contains-element-left-ideal-element-Semiring R x)
```
